screens.title: 완성 예상 1 · 인터벌 바로 편집
screens.caption: 운동 13:20 + 휴식 01:00 = 총 14:20. 현재 방식·직접 입력·진행 순서를 한 화면에 놓고 타이머 반영은 한 번으로 정리한다.
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high-fidelity finished-state mobile app mockup to illustrate the already-written CloudBoard timer UX plan in a Linear issue. One coherent proposed screen, NOT alternative concepts. This is a design mockup, not a screenshot of an implemented app.
Input image: the attached user screenshot is the existing timer editor. Use it as the exact product visual-language reference (white, muted lavender, dark gray, restrained rounded shapes, Korean Pretendard typography). Redesign its information hierarchy according to the following precise agreed brief; do not recreate its confusing old button stack.
Target: one full-bleed portrait app-content frame with the proportions of a 390 x 844 logical-pixel mobile viewport. Render at high resolution, ideally 1170 x 2532. No device bezel/body, OS status bar, clock, battery, notch, home indicator, browser chrome, outer decorative canvas, perspective, or device shadow.
Palette: white #FFFFFF background; primary ink #202028; muted #777683; accent #77729D; subtle surface #F5F4F8; borders #E6E3EF. Pretendard or extremely similar modern Korean sans serif, mostly medium weight, 14–16 logical px body, 26–32 px key numerals. Consistent 24 px horizontal margins, thoughtful spacing, no crowded cards-in-cards, minimal line icons, flat product UI.
User: fitness coach editing an existing INTERVAL timer for WAVE ZONE (CASH IN). Keep the exact existing timer settings, not reset defaults: work 13 minutes 20 seconds, rest 1 minute, 1 repeat, include final rest ON, total 14 minutes 20 seconds.
Composition from top to bottom:
1. Simple white app header with a small X close icon left and Korean title “타이머 편집”. No apply/save action at top.
2. Small muted slide-name eyebrow “WAVE ZONE (CASH IN)”. Below, strong heading “인터벌” at left, and compact quiet text action “방식 변경” with tiny chevron right on the same row. One short muted line “운동과 휴식을 번갈아 진행해요”.
3. A clean directly editable form: two equal columns, clear labels “운동 시간” and “휴식 시간”, softly bordered white inputs containing large tabular “13:20” and “01:00”, each with small “분:초” unit. Beneath, a full-width unobtrusive row “반복 횟수” with a minus control, “1회”, and a plus control on the right. Touch targets comfortably sized. A row “마지막 운동 뒤 휴식” with a lavender ON switch at right. This switch is ON and includes the final minute of rest.
4. A lightweight divider and one subdued chevron action row “구간별로 직접 편집”. This is a secondary action, not a second large CTA. Do not show the old expanded round/block list, “블록 추가”, “휴식만 추가”, or “타이머 간편 만들기”.
5. One pale lavender summary surface, carefully laid out: label “총 소요 시간” and bold accent total “14:20” aligned across its top. Underneath text “운동 13:20 · 휴식 01:00”. A light divider. A small label “진행 순서” and a minimal horizontal ordered sequence “운동 13:20” followed by an arrow and “휴식 01:00”. No extra decorative chart, scores, metrics or tags. A small play icon with text “시험 재생” may sit at the bottom-right of this summary surface. The total and sequence must be arithmetically correct.
6. Small muted helper “준비 카운트다운은 별도예요”.
7. Bottom pinned white action area with subtle top separator: one full-width filled accent #77729D button with white bold text “타이머 반영”. Under it, a readable short muted line “슬라이드에 반영한 뒤 저장해 주세요.” This is the sole primary CTA; it applies to a draft, so do NOT say “저장 완료” or invent autosave.
Quality: visually polished, realistic shippable Korean Flutter/iOS app UI, precise alignment, quiet hierarchy, ample whitespace, clear editable values, no clutter or giant empty gap. Keep ALL text sharp, correctly spelled Korean and fully within the viewport. Do not add English marketing copy, illustrations, logos, navigation tabs, device framing, or unrelated controls.

screens.title: 완성 예상 2 · EMOM 설정과 진행 순서
screens.caption: 2분 × 3구간 + 라운드 휴식 30초를 6라운드 반복한다. 마지막 라운드 휴식 포함으로 운동 36:00 + 휴식 03:00 = 총 39:00을 표시한다.
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create the second finished-state screen of the SAME CloudBoard timer editor design, showing the existing EMOM mode. This is not a new design option. Use the attached generated INTERVAL screen as the exact visual reference. Keep its width, portrait proportions (390 x 844 logical pixels), header, margins, restrained white/lavender palette, Pretendard-like Korean typography, line style, close icon, single bottom primary CTA and final-save helper. Output app content only at high resolution, no device frame/status bar/browser chrome.
Keep the top title “타이머 편집” and slide-name “WAVE ZONE (CASH IN)”.
Replace the mode heading with “EMOM”, keep “방식 변경” at right, and use short subtitle “일정한 간격마다 다음 구간을 시작해요”.
Replace the interval form with a clean 2 x 2 input grid, consistent large numeric inputs:
- top left label “구간 시간”, value “02:00”, small unit “분:초”
- top right label “라운드당 구간 수”, value “3”, small unit “개”
- bottom left label “라운드 휴식”, value “00:30”, small unit “분:초”
- bottom right label “전체 라운드”, value “6”, small unit “회”
Below the grid, a switch row “마지막 라운드 뒤 휴식” with switch ON in lavender. Optional short helper “마지막 라운드에도 30초 휴식해요.” Do NOT show the interval-specific repetition row or per-block final-rest toggle.
Next a quiet divider row “구간별로 직접 편집” with chevron.
The single subtle lavender summary surface must show exact mathematically correct values:
heading “총 소요 시간”, large “39:00”.
Below “운동 36:00 · 휴식 03:00”.
A divider, small title “진행 순서”.
A compact legible sequence representing a SINGLE ROUND: “02:00 → 02:00 → 02:00 → 휴식 00:30”. Four compact aligned units or clean text are fine, NEVER clip or split a time value.
Below “위 순서를 6라운드 반복”.
A small play icon/text action “시험 재생”.
All 6 rounds include 30 seconds rest; total work 36 minutes and rest 3 minutes is 39 minutes. Do not display 38:30 anywhere in this screen.
Beneath summary, helper “준비 카운트다운은 별도예요.”
Bottom pinned action area: sole filled lavender button “타이머 반영”, followed by helper “슬라이드에 반영한 뒤 저장해 주세요.”
Ensure Korean is accurate and legible, no crowding, use modest vertical spacing to keep all content inside the 390 x 844 viewport. Preserve the established design; no additional features, charts, tabs, badges or extra save/apply buttons.

screens.title: 완성 예상 3 · 방식 변경 전 구성 비교
screens.caption: EMOM 39:00에서 AMRAP 10:00으로 바꿀 때 사라지는 구간·라운드·휴식 설정을 확인한다. 취소하면 직전 초안을 유지하며 구성 교체는 최종 슬라이드 저장과 구별한다.
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create the THIRD STATE of the SAME CloudBoard mobile timer editor design, showing a safe confirmation before replacing an EMOM timer with an AMRAP timer. This is one coherent flow, NOT a new visual option.
Reference image: attached finished EMOM editor. Preserve its visual identity, same 390 x 844 logical viewport ratio, header and typography, white #FFFFFF, ink #202028, muted #777683, lavender accent #77729D, light surface #F5F4F8 and line #E6E3EF. Render sharp high-resolution Korean app UI. No phone bezel/notch/status bar/home indicator or outside canvas.
Background: retain the referenced EMOM editor as it is, recognizable at the top, covered by a neutral translucent dim overlay to signal a modal. Do not change the background's current EMOM 39:00 settings.
Foreground: a polished white bottom sheet, rounded top corners only, covering roughly the bottom 65% of the viewport, with comfortable 24px side padding. Its real content must fit and remain legible. Small top drag indicator is optional, close X may appear at top right. No illustration.
Sheet content, precise Korean text and hierarchy:
small overline “타이머 방식 변경”
strong title “AMRAP으로 바꿀까요?”
short description “현재 구간과 라운드 설정이 새 타이머로 바뀝니다.”
A clean BEFORE/AFTER comparison with row separation or two lightly tinted flat areas, not excessive nested cards:
First block:
“현재 · EMOM” with total “39:00” aligned right.
“2분 × 3구간 · 6라운드”
“라운드 휴식 30초 포함”
Then a small downward arrow or subtle transition rule.
Second block:
“변경 후 · AMRAP” with “10:00” aligned right.
“10분 동안 연속 운동”
“시간이 끝나면 다음 슬라이드로 이동”
A concise explanatory note with small information icon:
“구간 3개와 라운드 반복·휴식 설정이 사라져요.”
Keep note readable; wrap intentionally over two lines if necessary.
A final quiet line “슬라이드는 아직 저장되지 않아요.”
Bottom action row: secondary bordered button “취소” left, primary filled lavender button “구성 교체” right. Both large accessible touch targets. This replaces the bottom area; do NOT show a second active “타이머 반영” button through the sheet.
Purpose: show exactly what is replaced and let the user cancel with their previous draft intact. Do not imply that this saves the slide or that the current timer has already changed. Do not add red alarm styling, irreversible account warnings, extra steps, marketing text or new features. Keep all Korean spelling correct and spacing polished.
